_comment: Fonts bundled with the app and offered to everyone who opens it.
TO ADD ONE: put the .ttf or .otf next to this file and add an entry below.
key   unique id, also used in saved annotations. Don't rename it later.
label what shows in the font dropdown.
cjk   true if it covers Chinese/Japanese/Korean. One cjk font is used
automatically when text can't be encoded by the standard fonts.
ONLY put a font here if its licence permits redistribution — this folder
is committed to a public repo. A font you may use but not redistribute
(most commercial and brand fonts) goes in via 字體 -> 從這台電腦加入字體,
which keeps it in your browser only.
